objective: Semantic state-only snapshot into a paused KVM VM/vCPU previously used by another logical microVM; fixed shared DAX RAM allocation

earlier_failed_trials.optimized-smoke: Post-measurement log collection failed because BusyBox base64 applet was absent; retained as failed, replaced collector with uuencode -m and reran.
earlier_failed_trials.pre_final_strict_profile_collection: An earlier 12-handoff trial lacked timing rows due to info logger rate limiting; retained original logs, fixed only experiment log callsites and reran.

definitions.snapshot: Full source snapshot/create HTTP API round trip after Pause; CPU/VM/device GET state, serialization and state-file write. No guest RAM copy.
definitions.restore: Full destination snapshot/load HTTP API round trip, with resume_vm=false. Reuse includes validation and all IRQFD/state restore operations.
definitions.save_restore: Per measured round source snapshot_us + destination restore_us, then percentile; independent percentile values are never added.
definitions.save_transport_restore: Per round save_restore + source publish_us + receiver receive_us.
definitions.handoff: Source Pause request begin through observation of remote guest heartbeat ACK. Includes API, polling, thread wakeup and first resumed guest work.
definitions.cold_preparation: Pool worker coldboot and disposable guest execution excluded from handoff timing; explicitly paid in advance.
definitions.profile: Separate profiled 100-round runs; child scopes are nested and cannot be added to parent scopes.

environment.physical_topology: Two independent Linux L1 kernels under nested KVM on one physical host; emulated shared CXL/DAX
environment.memory_allocation: Same DAX device rdev, byte offset and GPA layout on every reuse. No switching to a different DAX allocation.
environment.cpu_profile: Existing direct CPU model with PMU/deadline/PV-host-address features masked, additionally nested VMX/SVM disabled and NX required
environment.devices: Diskless MMIO, output-only UART, ACPI VMGenID/VMClock, disabled PIT; no block/net/vsock/PCI
environment.nx_huge_pages: never only in this user-authorized experimental pair
environment.rcu: Primary comparison rcu_expedited=1, rcu_normal=0 only in new L1 pair; default rcu_expedited=0 separately measured

implementation.entry: FC_DAX_REUSE=1 enables paused runtime /snapshot/load; default snapshot path remains available
retained: native struct kvm/kvm_vcpu and VMCS allocation per destination
device buses and eventfd kernel objects
implementation.transferred: Existing semantic snapshot state (~13.7 KB) through shared mailbox. No struct kvm pointers or raw VMCS bytes serialized.
implementation.translation: Temporarily toggle current EFER.NX, forcing MMU context reset, then restore final architectural state before KVM_RUN. EPT root/leaves may remain valid because GPA->PFN does not change; stale CPU translations are explicitly flushed.
implementation.isolation: Strict IRQFD deassign synchronizes old injection work, drains counters and re-registers after state restore. Partial mutation failure permanently blocks Resume.
implementation.unsupported_alternative: Quiet IRQFD mode skips deassign/re-register and is only a limited no-I/O comparison, not general isolation.

source_inventory_contents.scope: Incremental source-only changes from the preserved pre-reuse implementation to the final EFER.NX reuse implementation. No kernel, binary, generated assets, report JSON or documentation included in patches.

files.role: Optional no-nested guest CPU profile, immutable MSR index schema, unrestricted CPU-state evidence logging.
Apply VM IRQ/clock state through a shared reference; quiesce and validate disabled PIT; restore resource allocator under its lock.
Initialize fail-closed reuse status in existing cold-boot, snapshot and test VMM constructors.
Refresh VMGenID and restore VMClock in existing devices, preserving IRQ eventfd contexts.
Expose ACPI snapshot fields within the crate for strict layout validation and in-place restore.
Replace guest-visible VMClock contents while retaining the registered interrupt eventfd.
Reset keyboard controller guest-visible state while retaining eventfds.
Restore an output-only UART within its existing Arc and preserve underlying eventfd contexts and output.
Opt-in reuse module; poison partially restored workers; prevent resume after failure; profile saves; route acknowledged Paused saves without a kick.
Expose existing DAX and snapshot reader helpers; add save/restore phase profiling without the logger rate limit.
New opt-in semantic restore controller, immutable CPU contract cache, hardware and DAX guards, strict IRQFD drain/rebind, same-object identity evidence, and four contract tests.
Allow runtime snapshot/load only for explicitly enabled reused workers; preserve ordinary post-boot API rejection.
Paused-thread RestoreState, pending IO completion before Pause acknowledgment, EFER.NX MMU invalidation, immutable contract capture, channel-only saves and identity evidence.
Same-VM identity evidence and channel-only save requests for already-paused vCPU threads.
Persistent-worker and seed-X benchmark orchestration, matched CPU/serial/IRQFD controls, per-stage timing collection, paired save/load costs and native-identity validation.
Reuse existing Firecracker processes across transfers; bootstrap and pause disposable seed guest; record native IDs; exercise snapshot APIs and expected negative HTTP statuses.
